gate_name: Stage 1 target nomination (example: formal soundness criterion)

requirements.description: The nominating hypothesis is formally sound: its formal object is not vacuous, not self-contradictory and falsifiable. Metric defect_count from `oase formal analyze`; met when it is at or below the max_formal_defects threshold (inclusive). A non-verdict (UNDECIDED, BLOCKED, ambiguous formalization) is not_assessed and leaves the requirement unevaluated; it is never a failure.

Prefer hypotheses that forbid more of their applicable state space (excluded_fraction_of_applicable in the analysis metrics). Informs ordering only. The threshold min_excluded_fraction_of_applicable is UNRESOLVED in formal@1.0: no value may be invented; until the program sets one in .oase/thresholds.yaml the fraction is recorded without a pass/fail.
